units.rate_integer: thousandths of one micro-USD per token
units.equivalence: USD per million tokens equals micro-USD per token; divide rate integers by 1000

maximum_input_status: Operational inference from the documented full-context definition, all ordinary/cache input categories counting toward that context, and rejection of over-context requests. Not a contractual indemnity or account billing certification.
projection_limits: These sums are conservative per-request envelopes, not expected spend or a grant. Serial settlement normally releases most reservations. No live output/usage has been observed.
Unknown delivery retains its full unpaid liability and halts; no retries, alternative routes or repair calls.

Quality deliberately reserves every known cache TTL, including 1h, although its scientific request omits cache_control. That is additional financial conservatism, not permission to add caching controls.

profile_prerequisite.required_before_live: Bind an explicit current public pay-as-you-go billing profile for the exact direct endpoints/model IDs to the new study, future grant and preflight. Unknown/private/Scale/Reserved/negotiated contracts are unsupported and block before dispatch; do not infer the profile from an API key.
profile_prerequisite.group: Preserve omitted service_tier, reasoning_effort and output cap. Omitted tier means auto, hence reserve Fast/priority as maximum public PAYG tier. Reserve documented long-context rates and 10 percent geography uplift. Default/flex/priority are supported settlement tiers; unknown/auto/unpriced scale are not settleable.
profile_prerequisite.sonnet: Explicit standard_only and global are already in its body. Existing accepted cache controls allow only 5m, so max applicable input rate is USD2.50/M. A returned 1h write remains unsupported.
profile_prerequisite.quality: Priority capacity excludes Opus5. Fast requires speed=fast and a beta header, both absent. Omitted inference_geo follows workspace default; only global/us are available, so reserve 1.1 geographic premium across all categories. Use conservative geographic settlement surcharge unless the applicable profile is attested; do not assume global from omission.

usage_normalization_requirements: ChatCompletions prompt_tokens includes reads and writes. base = prompt_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens; require nonnegative exact integers and read+write <= prompt.
Require explicit cache_write_tokens and cached_tokens for the GPT5.6 implicit-cache profile; missing optional fields are unresolved evidence, not proof of zero charge.

Require total_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens. Reasoning/text detail counts are breakdowns, not extra charges; validate their bounds. Reject unsupported nonzero modalities/prediction details or unknown nonzero fields.

Use returned known service tier and actual prompt length for exact public rate table settlement, or a documented conservative maximum where geography/profile is unattested; never assume missing tier means standard.
Preserve raw provider usage and unknown fields. Unknown usage/tier/contract leaves the reservation outstanding and stops; an SDK enum annotation is not a validator.
